title: Mine & Deposit Maps
selected_by_owner: Owner continued the approved 15-cycle MMHT standalone map authoring program after MMHT-10.

in_scope: Draw irregular, depth-bound resource deposit polygons, mine working faces, hazard extents, shafts, supports, surveys, ventilation, drainage, access drifts and haul routes; inspect named elevations and measured footprints.

Store optional DPL-06 source-site and density reference vocabulary, world owner refs, and GM survey notes as nonauthoritative map metadata. Attach mine roles to existing features while keeping their stable IDs.

Distinguish authored infrastructure links, direction, traversability and broken endpoints; preserve GM-only deposits in full drafts and omit all hidden geometry, labels and dependent links in player exports.
Provide standalone editable Brinegate mine and Lantern Post reference-copy examples, export and import, and access to earlier map editor tools.
boundaries: Map authoring only. Prospecting/extraction rolls, output/yields/depletion, labor, time, inventory, geology simulation, mining operation and hazard effects remain with DPL-06 and existing gameplay/World/Asset owner domains.
Standalone HTML testing is distinct from installed application integration, physical device testing and owner playtest acceptance.

evidence.validation: Standalone HTML executed with Chromium Playwright and native Canvas. Both mine examples passed documentError and MMHT-10 cave examples remained valid. Brinegate 19 GM / 17 player mine features (concealed deposit and gas hazard omitted entirely from player JSON and route links), 13 GM / 11 player authored mine links; deposit depth -24 m and authored density profile survived reference projection. Tested access/haul route reachability, one-way shaft, ventilation/drainage not traversable, GM-only hazard polygon drawing, metadata edits and stable owner refs, deleted endpoint diagnostics, full draft export/import with new geometry and owner reference intact, Lantern Post copied original stable feature IDs and retained concealed vein, browser error count zero. Direct about:blank storage unavailable, so the explicit file round trip was verified; installed app and Android untested.

next_action: Owner reviews Brinegate and Lantern Post mining geometry and filtered references; MMHT-12 Storage, Processing & Route Maps is planned.
successor_rule: Requires owner direction to start the next standalone HTML review cycle.

last_material_progress.evidence: MMHT-11 standalone HTML, two editable sample drafts and separate GM/player reference exports with passing browser tests.

stop_reason.evidence: Mine map authoring, depth-bound deposits, explicit links, privacy filtering and editable export/reimport verified.
